mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_orders ( ORDER_NO, USER_NO, ORDER_STATUS, PAYMENT_STATUS, TOTAL_ITEM_AMOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT, RECEIVER_NAME, RECEIVER_PHONE, ZIP_CODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, ORDER_MEMO, ORDERED_AT, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userNo}, #{orderStatus}, #{paymentStatus}, #{totalItemAmount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalPayAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{orderMemo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO tb_order_items ( ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, OPTION_NAME, UNIT_PRICE, QUANTITY, ITEM_TOTAL_AMOUNT, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{optionName}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{itemTotalAmount}, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_orders SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, PAYMENT_STATUS = #{paymentStatus}, PAID_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'PAID' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE PAID_AT END, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'CANCEL' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_payments ( ORDER_ID, USER_NO, PAYMENT_STATUS, PAYMENT_METHOD, PG_PROVIDER, PG_TID, MERCHANT_UID, AMOUNT_TOTAL, AMOUNT_TAX_FREE, AMOUNT_VAT, CURRENCY, CARD_COMPANY, CARD_NUMBER_MASKED, CARD_INSTALLMENT_MONTH, RECEIPT_URL, PAID_AT, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userNo}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{pgProvider}, #{pgTid}, #{merchantUid}, #{amountTotal}, #{amountTaxFree}, #{amountVat}, #{currency}, #{cardCompany}, #{cardNumberMasked}, #{cardInstallmentMonth}, #{receiptUrl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_payments SET PAYMENT_STATUS = #{paymentStatus}, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{paymentStatus} = 'CANCELLED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, FAIL_CODE = #{failCode}, FAIL_MESSAGE = #{failMessage}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PG_TID = #{pgTid} OR MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS = 'PAID' AND DATE(REGIST_DT) = CURDATE() THEN AMOUNT_TOTAL ELSE 0 END), 0) as todayTotalAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS = 'PAID' AND DATE(REGIST_DT) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as todayPaidCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' AND DATE(REGIST_DT) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as todayCancelledCount FROM tb_payments
SELECT P.*, O.ORDER_NO, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ZIP_CODE, O.ADDRESS1, O.ADDRESS2 FROM tb_payments P JOIN tb_orders O ON P.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE P.PAYMENT_ID = #{paymentId}
